description: Workspace conventions for frontend testing in the Angular application.
applyTo: "**/*.ts, **/*.html"

# Frontend Testing Memory

Keep frontend implementation focused on the application code; this project does not write frontend tests.

## Frontend test scope

Do not add Angular, TypeScript, component, service, or template test files for frontend code in this project. Backend behavior remains covered by the integration-test and unit-test conventions in `dotnet-tests.memory.instructions.md`.
